clue.text: Offer reason for retreat

parts.note: to offer something is to give it
a reason or basis for an argument is its ground

explanation.surface: Someone puts forward an excuse for backing off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreat' sits at the end looking like part of the phrase 'reason for retreat', but it is the definition, as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To yield territory or concede in an argument is an idiom for withdrawing or backing down.

clue.text: Dress to pass in two directions

parts.note: to pass, as time passes, is to go
W and N are the compass abbreviations for west and north

explanation.surface: A garment that can be passed along either way.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal robe or long frock is a kind of dress worn on special occasions.

clue.text: Several that are different

explanation.surface: A number of things that each differ.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both numerous (several items) and of differing kinds (assorted, diverse).

clue.text: Travel agency still in operation?

parts.note: to travel is to be going somewhere
a business or agency is a concern, as in a commercial firm

explanation.surface: A holiday firm that is still trading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Travel agency' reads as one business, but it splits into two pieces; the question mark flags the playful definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Accountants call a business that is solvent and trading normally by this idiom.

clue.text: Sorting out inclusion of a musician

indicators.note: the inclusion of something means taking it inside, so the letter that follows is put within the mixed letters
sorting out a muddle rearranges it, so the letters of the word before are mixed up

explanation.surface: Arranging to add a player to a band.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges SORTING, and 'inclusion of' puts A inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard player at a church, cathedral or concert hall is one kind of musician.

clue.text: Subtle difference pest is leaving

indicators.note: leaving means departing, so the word that comes before it goes out of the larger word

parts.note: a pest is an annoying nuisance
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fine distinction: the annoying insect has gone.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight shade of meaning or tone is a fine distinction.

clue.text: Having climbed a southern tree

parts.note: someone who has climbed is up

explanation.surface: After scaling a tree in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: A poisonous Javanese tree whose sap was used on arrows; a crossword favourite.

clue.text: Many before second half of summer found starch

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of what follows it

parts.note: poly- is the Greek prefix meaning many

indicators.note: the second half of a six-letter word is its last three letters

explanation.surface: Lots of people found starch ahead of the end of summer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second half of' takes MER from SUMMER.
explanation.definitionFit: Starch is a natural compound of long chains of glucose units, an example of a large chain molecule.

clue.text: Endlessly tolerating drink whilst taking the place of another

indicators.note: endlessly means without its end, so the last letter of the word after is dropped

parts.note: tolerating something is standing it, as in 'I can't stand it'
gin is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: Someone drinking without pause while deputising for another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' cuts the final G from STANDING, leaving STANDIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To substitute or deputise for someone is a phrasal verb meaning to replace them temporarily.

clue.text: Duty period operative 24 hours afterwards

indicators.note: afterwards puts the next piece after the one before

parts.note: a machine that is operative is working
a day lasts 24 hours

explanation.surface: A shift that is active and then a full day afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A shift or time spent on the job is the span of a day spent at work.

clue.text: Leading actor left Georgia some bladderwrack perhaps

indicators.note: the leading letter of a word is its first one

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: A star performer quit Georgia, maybe leaving some seaweed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' marks the definition as an example: bladderwrack is a brown seaweed.
explanation.definitionFit: Bladderwrack is a seaweed, and seaweeds are simple water plants of that class.

clue.text: University making delayed recovery on its own

parts.note: something delayed is late
a rally is a recovery, as in share prices or health

explanation.surface: A college recovering late, without any help.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting by one side alone, without the agreement of others, is acting independently.

clue.text: Solomon's melodious utterance?

parts.note: the Old Testament book called the ___ of Solomon, read as a tune sung by the king

explanation.surface: The wise king's tuneful words.
explanation.definitionFit: A melodious utterance is a sung piece, and the biblical Song of Solomon is attributed to him.

clue.text: Satan so-called!

parts.note: Old Nick is a familiar name for Satan
something so-called has been named that

explanation.surface: The Devil, as he is known!
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: Satan is called Old Nick.
explanation.definitionFit: Given an informal name, which is just how the Devil came to be called Old Nick.

clue.text: Go into book to find natural source of energy

indicators.note: into puts the word before it inside the word after it

parts.note: a primer is an elementary book for beginners
to go is to move

explanation.surface: Consult a textbook to discover where natural power comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: In philosophy the first cause of all motion is the original driving force, here a natural energy source.

clue.text: One of the service replies

parts.note: a church service has set lines the congregation says back to the priest; this is one of them

explanation.surface: A single answer given in a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: In liturgy, a reply said or sung by the congregation is the term for each answering line.

clue.text: Old money Florence left half at home

indicators.note: the left half of an eight-letter word is its first four letters

parts.note: someone at home is in

explanation.surface: Florence left half her old cash at home.
explanation.walkthrough: A FLORIN was a British two-shilling coin, replaced by the 10p piece at decimalisation in 1971.
explanation.definitionFit: The two-shilling coin was pre-decimal British currency, so old money.

clue.text: I apply thick layer round column

indicators.note: round puts the first piece around the letter given

parts.note: to plaster something is to apply a thick layer to it

explanation.surface: Someone coating a pillar heavily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts I inside PLASTER, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A rectangular pier projecting from a wall is a flat decorative pillar.

clue.text: Lizard had short time by Scottish lake

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a short time
loch is the Scottish word for a lake

explanation.surface: A lizard spent a moment beside a Scottish lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorny devil, a spiny Australian reptile, bears this name.

clue.text: A medical man involved in final thrash

indicators.note: involved in means taken inside, so the first pieces go within the word that follows

parts.note: the final one is the last
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's degree, so a medical man

explanation.surface: A doctor takes part in the last beating.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat or attack verbally means to criticise severely or batter someone.

clue.text: Musicians that were good without you, say, I concluded

indicators.note: concluded means coming at the end, so the final piece goes last
without means lacking, so the letter that follows is removed from the word before

parts.note: people that were good were virtuous

indicators.note: say signals that the word is to be replaced by a letter that sounds like it

parts.note: the word you is said aloud as the letter U

explanation.surface: Players who behaved well without you, I decided.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes a U (sounding like 'you', signalled by 'say') from VIRTUOUS, giving VIRTUOS; 'concluded' adds I at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Highly skilled performers, especially instrumentalists, are masters of their art.

clue.text: Says our development is vault for bones

indicators.note: development here means change of form, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A person comments on how something of ours has progressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'development' rearranges the letters of SAYS and OUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A charnel house or container where skeletal remains of the dead are kept.

clue.text: Bring into force

parts.note: reads as making a law take effect, but force means an army or other service that people join

explanation.surface: Make a rule take effect.
explanation.definitionFit: To sign someone up for the armed services is to recruit them.

clue.text: Norma made complicated notes

indicators.note: complicated means mixed up, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Norma wrote some fiddly notes.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin plural of a written reminder or note kept for future reference.

clue.text: Got up in the garden?

explanation.surface: Someone getting out of bed outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both the past tense of arise (stood or got out of bed) and a flower found growing in many gardens.

clue.text: Sell less than half-a-dozen before the finish

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the next

parts.note: five is less than six, and V is the Roman numeral five
the finish is the end

explanation.surface: Get rid of fewer than six before closing time.
explanation.definitionFit: To vend is to offer goods for money, as from a machine or stall.

clue.text: Not a pleasant-sounding bottle

indicators.note: sounding signals that what is heard is a word spelt differently

parts.note: something not at all pleasant is vile

explanation.surface: An unattractive-looking small bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue's 'pleasant-sounding' reads as one adjective, but 'sounding' is the homophone signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A small glass container for medicine or perfume is a little flask.

clue.text: Said little about concentrated essence

indicators.note: about can mean in a disordered way, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone said little about something essential.
explanation.definitionFit: A liquid obtained by evaporating and condensing, purified and strong, is the product of a still.

clue.text: Liturgical procedure correct to be heard

indicators.note: to be heard signals that the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: correct means right

explanation.surface: A church ritual is accurate when spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal religious ceremony or ritual is a ceremonial act of worship.

clue.text: Extremely optimistic having remoulded tyres ready

indicators.note: a remoulded tyre is reshaped, so the letters of the words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Retreaded tyres are ready to roll, says a hopeful dreamer.
explanation.definitionFit: Naively idealistic and dreamy, seeing the world through rose-tinted glasses.
